findings.text: non-blocking: `_with_change_set` (reckon/mcp_views.py:4047) duplicates the change-set attach-and-error glue already owned by `_answer_with_change_set` (reckon/mcp.py:2595) instead of delegating to one helper, and the two copies already disagree: the mcp.py copy attaches to any project including `*`/`graph:` and passes `repo=None` for those, while the views copy returns untouched when `project` is falsy and always passes `checkout_path`; a later fix to one error contract leaves the other serving a different document on the roadmap and crew surfaces. mcp.py already imports mcp_views (reckon/mcp.py:109), so a single owner in mcp_views was available; the addition duplicates rather than extends it.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against the base: merge 483632cc0e is lossless for the node's files (reckon/mcp.py blob equals the node parent 4ff7ec4746, reckon/mcp_views.py blob equals origin/main parent 65fbbaaaf6, and main changed neither mcp.py nor the node's new files, so no side was dropped); fix b38c17f03f returns an answer untouched when since is None (reckon/mcp.py:2626), removes the crew-layer attach from `_crew` (reckon/mcp.py:2905 now returns serve_crew_view directly), and adds `_with_change_set` inside serve_crew_view (reckon/mcp_views.py:4047) so both surfaces compose the same document.
item_verdicts.done_when: the §7 measure is a fixture read naming the one moved declaration, the dependents it released and the one moved run; tests/test_a_read_can_ask_what_changed.py:232-262 asserts exactly those, the fix leaves them intact, and logs/gate-merge.log records 72 passed with a bare EXIT=0 at b38c17f03f for that file plus tests/test_mcp_recovery.py and tests/test_crew_view_serves_every_view.py.
item_verdicts.goal: the reviewed node's goal is that the brief, crew live and the roadmap answer the existing `since` with a change set and an `observed_at`; the fix keeps that (reckon/mcp.py:2592 for the roadmap, reckon/mcp_views.py:4506 for crew live) and narrows attachment so a read naming no window returns its view's own document.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the delivered manifest; it states the gate at b38c17f03f as 72 passed EXIT=0 across tests/test_mcp_recovery.py, tests/test_crew_view_serves_every_view.py, tests/test_a_read_can_ask_what_changed.py and tests/test_mcp_tools.py, and names the two failures the fix answers; I read those figures from logs/gate-merge.log, whose header names the same revision and literal command.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed run declared reckon/change_set.py, reckon/mcp.py, tests/test_a_read_can_ask_what_changed.py and the evidence fragment; comparing file blobs at both merge parents shows the merge carried mcp.py from the node's parent (4e8e2bb6) and mcp_views.py from main (53354015), with change_set.py and the test unchanged, and the fix adds reckon/mcp_views.py, which is outside the run's original manifest grant but is named in this review's declared targets.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_read_can_ask_what_changed.py:565-566 asserts `observed_at` and `change_set` are absent from a no-window read, which reddens if reckon/mcp.py:2626 is reverted; the crew-surface relocation is guarded only by the pre-existing tests/test_crew_view_serves_every_view.py:403, outside this run's write scope.
justifications.evidence: logs/gate-merge.log names revision b38c17f03f, the tree, the module and the literal command, and ends in a bare EXIT=0 at `72 passed`, matching the manifest's recorded gate.
justifications.fit: reckon/mcp_views.py:4047 follows the module's local-import and docstring idiom seen at reckon/mcp_views.py:4508, adds no plan or ticket label, and the visible error path keeps the same `type: message` shape as reckon/mcp.py:2637.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/mcp.py:2626 and reckon/mcp_views.py:4076 leave an answer untouched when `since` is None, so roadmap(view=raw) is again exactly {project, view, data} as tests/test_mcp_recovery.py:411 requires, while a named window still attaches the change set.
justifications.reuse: reckon/mcp_views.py:4047 duplicates rather than extends reckon/mcp.py:2595, so the change-set attach glue now has two owners; the composition itself still delegates to the real owner, change_set_module.change_set.
justifications.scope_discipline: the fix commit touches only reckon/mcp.py, reckon/mcp_views.py and tests/test_a_read_can_ask_what_changed.py; mcp_views.py sits outside the run's original manifest grant but is named in this review's declared scope, and nothing else was touched.
